POL001: Reservations must be cancelled at least 24 hours before the booking time.

POL002: Outside food and beverages are not permitted inside the restaurant.

POL003: Pets are not allowed in indoor dining areas.

POL004: Customers must arrive within 15 minutes of their reservation time.

POL005: Tables are held for a maximum of 15 minutes after the reserved time.

POL006: Smoking is prohibited inside the restaurant premises.

POL007: Payment must be completed before leaving the restaurant.

POL008: Group reservations for more than 10 guests require advance confirmation.

POL009: Decorations for private events require prior approval.

POL010: Customers are responsible for any intentional property damage.

POL011: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

POL012: Management reserves the right to refuse service for inappropriate behavior.

POL013: Buffet items cannot be taken outside the restaurant.

POL014: Customers must inform staff of food allergies before placing orders.

POL015: Reserved event spaces require a non-refundable deposit.

POL016: Refunds are only issued for verified billing errors.

POL017: Promotional offers cannot be combined unless stated otherwise.

POL018: Takeaway orders must be collected within 30 minutes of preparation.

POL019: Delivery orders are available only within designated service areas.

POL020: Customers must present valid identification for age-restricted items.

POL021: Restaurant closing time is strictly enforced.

POL022: Large parties may be subject to an automatic service charge.

POL023: Lost items are kept for 30 days before disposal.

POL024: Customers may request receipts for all transactions.

POL025: Parking is available at the customer's own risk.

POL026: Management may modify operating hours during holidays.

POL027: Special dietary requests are subject to ingredient availability.

POL028: Private event bookings must be confirmed at least seven days in advance.
